programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette, Howard Johnson, Greg Osby & John Purcell
programme.sub-title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007. His style combines elements of jazz, free jazz, world music and R & B, and his versatility makes him a regarded and in-demand drummer. Discover his unique style as part of this breathtaking performance delivered at Estival.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's "Resurrection" Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale. The symphony features immense orchestral forces, including offstage brass and a large choir, which combine to create overwhelming sonic experiences that depict profound spiritual and emotional narratives. The grand scale and dramatic structure represent the triumph of life over death.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances and leading violinist David Grimal by Symphony No. 8 by Ludwig van Beethoven at the Opéra Dijon in France. Beethoven spent the summer of 1812 in Bohemia, in the spas of Teplitz and Carlsbad. During his stay in Teplitz, he wrote his famous love letter to his "Immortal Beloved ", which inspired Symphony No. 8. The symphony is distinguished by its simplicity and its overall duration, which returns to the classical proportions of Symphony No. 1. Only the finale brings a little extravagance, contrasting with the conventional form of the first three movements in a more modest way that presents an interesting solo treatment of the instruments.

programme.title: Kevin John Edusei
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and leads the orchestra in a beautiful performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's “A Midsummer Night's Dream”, Boulanger's “D'un matin de printemps” and Schumann's 'Spring' Symphony. Edusei is regularly praised for the drama and tension that he brings to his music-making, and for his clear sense of architecture and attention to detail.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

Discover abundant wonders of Nature in some of her most dazzling displays from the old-growth forests and rocky coastlines of the Pacific Northwest, to the other-worldly rock formations and majestic waterfalls found in the Southwest, viewers will quickly discover just why America offers arguably the most beautiful & diverse natural wonders in the world. programme.title: The Wedding Stalker
programme.desc: A dressmaker longs to have a wedding of her own with the man of her dreams. And she will stop at nothing to have it - even if it means killing his bride to be.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

programme.title: A Monster Calls
programme.desc: From the director of THE IMPOSSIBLE and the producers of PAN'S LABRYNTH, A MONSTER CALLS is a searing and fantastical story of one boy's journey to confront the truth.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Undercover Agent Malcolm Turner is back and this time he's out to expose the suspected designer of a deadly computer "worm" that would allow outside forces access to sophistical and critical government intelligence files.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: Charro!
programme.desc: Vince Hackett's gang steals a prized victory cannon from Mexico and blames the deed on ex-gang member Jess Wade, who wants to go straight.

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: In Australia's Outback during the early twentieth century, the impoverished Carmody family lives a nomadic life out of their wagon, but the mom and son want to settle, while the dad is against it.

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: Lonely Maiden Productions, LLC. All Rights Reserved. Under exclusive license to Signature Entertainment Ltd 2008

programme.title: Queen Of The Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attaché for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

programme.title: Snitch (2013)
programme.desc: A father (Dwayne Johnson) goes undercover for the DEA in order to free his son who was imprisoned after being set up in a drug deal.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi.

programme.title: Seeking Justice
programme.desc: After his wife is assaulted, a husband enlists the services of a vigilante group to help him settle the score.

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: On a ship, an arrested assassin breaks free and releases a 400 lbs. white jaguar.

programme.title: Drive Angry
programme.desc: Felon John Milton is so devastated to learn that his daughter has been murdered by an evil cult that he escapes hell to rescue his granddaughter, with a mysterious FBI agent hot on his heels.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: A Family Man
programme.desc: From the Writer of The Accountant and Ozark comes an unforgettably moving drama with an all-star cast featuring Gerard Butler, Gretchen Mol, and Willem Dafoe. A head-hunter, desperate to climb to the top of the corporate ladder, grows distant from his family as his life increasingly revolves around closing deals in a survival-of-the-fittest boiler room. But these dreams suddenly grind to a halt when his son is diagnosed with a life-threatening illness.

programme.title: Blame
programme.desc: This award-winning, coming-of-age drama stars Quinn Shephard (The Miseducation of Cameron Post). When the new drama teacher casts Abigail over Melissa in their adaptation of Arthur Miller's The Crucible, Abigail's confidence and relationship with him blooms. Fuelled by jealousy, Melissa spirals out of control and concocts a vengeful plot against Abigail. A raw, scandalous fight like no other!

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The true story of Scottish Olympic runner, Eric Liddell, who was captured by the Japanese, during WWII. In a concentration camp, he experienced a world of torture and cruelty and was forced to resort to one final decision to ensure his survival.

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: Striving for justice, this non-stop, gun-toting western thriller stars Bill Pullman and Peter Fonda. Always the grizzled sidekick and never the hero, Lefty is pushed into the limelight when his best friend and longtime partner Edward is brutally murdered. In efforts to seek revenge, he is placed at odds with vested interests, hired guns, corrupt officials and his own abundant failings.

programme.title: Into The Ashes
programme.desc: With an honest job and a loving wife, Nick Brenner believed he had safely escaped his violent, criminal history. programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette, Howard Johnson, Greg Osby & John Purcell
programme.sub-title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007. His style combines elements of jazz, free jazz, world music and R & B, and his versatility makes him a regarded and in-demand drummer. Discover his unique style as part of this breathtaking performance delivered at Estival.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's "Resurrection" Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale. The symphony features immense orchestral forces, including offstage brass and a large choir, which combine to create overwhelming sonic experiences that depict profound spiritual and emotional narratives. The grand scale and dramatic structure represent the triumph of life over death.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances and leading violinist David Grimal by Symphony No. 8 by Ludwig van Beethoven at the Opéra Dijon in France. Beethoven spent the summer of 1812 in Bohemia, in the spas of Teplitz and Carlsbad. During his stay in Teplitz, he wrote his famous love letter to his "Immortal Beloved ", which inspired Symphony No. 8. The symphony is distinguished by its simplicity and its overall duration, which returns to the classical proportions of Symphony No. 1. Only the finale brings a little extravagance, contrasting with the conventional form of the first three movements in a more modest way that presents an interesting solo treatment of the instruments.

programme.title: Kevin John Edusei
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and leads the orchestra in a beautiful performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's “A Midsummer Night's Dream”, Boulanger's “D'un matin de printemps” and Schumann's 'Spring' Symphony. Edusei is regularly praised for the drama and tension that he brings to his music-making, and for his clear sense of architecture and attention to detail.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Avril Lavigne
programme.desc: The Canadian Avril Lavigne enchanted the public in 2007 at her show in Calgary (Canada), in which she released the album “The Best Damn Thing”, which sold, that same year, more than 6 million copies worldwide. The pop singer rocked the audience to the sound of “Girlfriend” as well as other great hits like “Complicated” and “I'm With You”. programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". programme.title: La Sospechosa
programme.desc: Beth ha sido acusada de matar a su marido. Todos creen que es culpable, hasta que aparece Jerry, un investigador de una aseguradora que le da el beneficio de la duda.

programme.title: La Impostora
programme.desc: Una joven aspirante a actriz es contratada para sustituir a la esposa de un empresario durante una importante recepción en su casa. Lo que parecía un trabajo sencillo se convertirá en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Capilla de Boda, La
programme.desc: Sarah es una pintora sin inspiración, soltera, tiene mala suerte y quiere escapar de sus problemas. Decide visitar a su madre, y se involucra en salvar una iglesia local que está en peligro de cerrar.

programme.title: Consejo de guerra
programme.desc: Sudáfrica, 1901. Tres lugartenientes australianos son sometidos a un consejo de guerra por asesinato. El oficial encargado del proceso lee las notas preliminares que implican a Harry Harbord ‘Breaker' Morant, George Witton y Peter Handcock de la muerte de un misionero alemán y de varios prisioneros Boer confinados en una prisión custodiada por el ejército inglés. El oficial defensor, el Comandante Thomas, entiende que el proceso presenta ciertas irregularidades.

programme.title: El liquidador
programme.desc: Una pareja de tendencias voyeurísticas, un tasador de seguros obsesionado con solucionar la vida a sus clientes, y una censora de películas pornográficas, se convierten en sujetos cinematográficos por el capricho sexual de sus vecinos.

programme.title: Enigma
programme.desc: Alex Holbeck, desertor de Alemania Oriental convertido en agente de la CIA, es elegido para descubrir los nombres de cinco disidentes soviéticos a los que persigue un despiadado escuadrón de la KGB. Al llegar a Berlín Oriental, la tapadera de Alex se descubre rápidamente y busca refugio con su examante, Karen.

programme.title: Orlando
programme.desc: Después de que la reina Isabel I le ordena no envejecer, un joven noble lucha con el amor y su lugar en el mundo.

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Un médico británico lucha contra una epidemia de cólera en un pequeño pueblo chino, mientras está atrapado en un matrimonio sin amor con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión.

programme.title: Los amos de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Tres policías coincidirán en una redada en la zona más peligrosa y criminalizada de Brooklyn.

programme.title: Parecía un hombre tranquilo
programme.desc: Un oficinista lucha con su nueva condición de héroe.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate.

programme.title: La Carretera
programme.desc: La película nos introduce en un mundo apocalíptico, arrasado por una explosión nuclear.

programme.title: Ámsterdam
programme.desc: Un misterio épico sobre una sorprendente trama secreta de la historia de EE. UU.

programme.title: El caso Sloane
programme.desc: Maquiavélica película en clave de thriller político tenso y locuaz que recuerda a los mejores guiones de Aaron Sorkin ('El ala oeste de la casa blanca'). Una implacable y ambiciosa activista luchará contra un poderoso lobby en un intento de cambiar la legislación sobre el control y venta de armas.

programme.title: La casa de la esperanza
programme.desc: Una historia conmovedora basada en el hecho real más curioso de la II GM. El director del zoo de Varsovia y su esposa (Jessica Chastain), ayudaron a salvar a cientos de personas (y también a muchos animales del Zoo) de los nazis tras la invasión de Polonia por las tropas alemanas en 1939.

programme.title: Volver a vivir
programme.desc: June despiera en el hospital al que había ingresado debido a su demencia, pero cuando lo hace sólo recuerda la vida que tenía 5 años atrás. Sabiendo que su lucidez es temporal, no tiene tiempo que perder y escapa del hospital.

programme.title: La canción de los nombres olvidados
programme.desc: En pleno estallido de la segunda Guerra Mundial, el pequeño Dovidl acaba de llegar a Londres como refugiado judío desde su Polonia natal. Con tan solo 9 años, es un prodigio del violín, lo que propicia su acogida en una destacada familia británica.

programme.title: Rey Lear
programme.desc: Un rey anciano provoca una tragedia al abdicar en favor de sus hijas corruptas y aduladoras, rechazando a la única que lo ama y es honesta.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, narra como en la Irlanda de los años cincuenta la pequeña Evelyn y sus dos hermanos son separados y enviados a distintos orfanatos católicos, cuando un tribunal decide que su padre es incapaz de cuidar de ellos.

programme.title: El que caminaba solo
programme.desc: Texas, año 1933. La joven maestra de escuela Novalyne Price conoce a un joven encantador, excéntrico e inestable emocionalmente, llamado Robert Howard. Robert es un escritor de cierto éxito en el campo de las novelas 'pulp', pues es el creador de "Conan el Bárbaro".

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Claude, un hombre viudo de unos setenta años, que vive solo y está desencantado con su única hija, se entera un día de que LILLIAN, la mujer que fue el el primer amor de su vida tiene Alzheimer y está ingresada en una residencia especializada.

programme.title: Emma (de Jane Austen)
programme.desc: Emma Woodhouse (Kate Beckinsale) es una atractiva joven de familia pudiente que ocupa su ocio en emparejar sentimentalmente a cuantos ella desea, aunque no siempre con buenos resultados.

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Bichos raros
programme.desc: Una comedia irónica que narra el romance estrafalario de dos inadaptados. Lily es tímida, poquita cosa, dulce y rara. Este último es el calificativo que más abunda sobre ella, la causa de que a sus espaldas todos la señalen a carcajadas. Aún así, para Lily eso no es motivo de amargura, al contrario: es feliz sabiéndose distinta. Trabaja como cajera en un restaurante de comida rápida, y ya ni escucha las burlas de sus propios compañeros. Está demasiado pendiente de una hora concreta al mediodía, porque ése es el momento en que aparece para comer Jarrod, alguien como ella, otro inadaptado. Jarrod trabaja en una tienda de videojuegos, se considera un genio y sale de una depresión para meterse en otra. Jarrod prepara una fiesta de disfraces donde cada invitado se vestirá como su animal favorito. El suyo es un águila, el de Lily un tiburón.

programme.title: 13 asesinos
programme.desc: La época de paz del Japón feudal se ve amenazada por la ascendente carrera en el poder de Lord Naritsugu, el despiadado hermano…

programme.title: Los signos del Apocalipsis
programme.desc: Cuando un misterioso planeta atraviesa el Sol, se desatan catástrofes globales. Un solitario científico es la clave para descifrar los símbolos, convirtiéndose en la única oportunidad que le queda a la humanidad para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Rescate en Nueva York
programme.desc: Cuando la encantadora Kim Chang es secuestrada en un sangriento ataque, el detective Connor Spears es requerido por su hermano Rick para rescatarla de la guerra que mantienen bandas chinas y rusas.

programme.title: Jappeloup. De padre a hijo
programme.desc: A principios de los 80, dejando una prometedora carrera como abogado, Pierre Durand decide dedicarse en cuerpo y alma a su pasión: el salto de obstáculos. Apoyado por su padre, lo apuesta todo por un joven caballo en que nadie tiene gran fe: Jappeloup. Demasiado pequeño, extraño, imprevisible, lleno de defectos aunque también con extraordinarias aptitudes. Juntos empiezan un camino de sacrificio, superación y trabajo que les convierte en leyenda olímpica.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Diferencias irreconciliables
programme.desc: Una niña precoz exige la emancipación de sus padres, sorprendiéndolos a ambos.

programme.title: Igelak
programme.desc: Pello decide huir y cambiar de identidad, pero acaba viviendo en un edificio okupa.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Max Simkin (Adam Sandler) repara zapatos en una tienda neoyorquina perteneciente a su familia. Desencantado con su rutina diaria, Max tropieza con una reliquia familiar que le permite ser testigo de la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara y ver el mundo de una forma nueva.

programme.title: Amor y otras drogas
programme.desc: Maggie es una mujer independiente que no deja que nada le ate. Pero conoce a Jamie, cuyo encanto le sirve bien tanto con las mujeres como dentro del mundo de las farmacéuticas. La evolución que sufre su relación coge a ambos por sorpresa, al encontrarse bajo la influencia de la droga final: el amor.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Begin Again
programme.desc: Éxito independiente del 2014 nominado al Oscar® a Mejor canción. Fresca historia llena de optimismo y buen rollo sobre el amor y la música como bálsamos de la felicidad.

programme.title: El Analfabeto
programme.desc: Cantinflas interpreta a un joven analfabeto que recibe una carta informándole de que un tío rico ha muerto y le ha dejado una gran fortuna. Pero para poder comprender la carta, antes deberá aprender a leer y escribir.

programme.title: Ejecutivo Agresivo
programme.desc: El empresario Dave Buznik es normalmente afable y nada polémico. Pero tras un altercado a bordo de un avión, es condenado a participar en un programa de gestión de la ira. Allí descubre que su propio instructor, el Dr. Buddy Rydell, tiene un grave problema de ira, un problema que solo se revelará del todo después de que el doctor se traslade a casa de Dave para darle lecciones prácticas sobre "comportamiento calmado".

programme.title: Hook (El Capitán Garfio)
programme.desc: A pesar de ser un abogado de éxito profesional y de tener una encantadora familia, Peter Banning ha perdido algo maravilloso, su propia infancia. Cuando sus hijos son secuestrados por un antiguo enemigo y llevados al País de Nunca Jamás, el también tiene que viajar a ese reino encantado. Sólo de esa manera puede recuperar a los suyos y también al niño que un día fue. Allí vivirá emocionantes y divertidas aventuras.

programme.title: Dos Rubias De Pelo En Pecho
programme.desc: El director de Scary Movie presenta WHITE CHICKS, una comedia de travestismo protagonizada por los comediantes Shawn Wayans y Marlon Wayans. ¿Qué sucede cuando dos agentes del FBI se disfrazan como princesas millonarias para infiltrarse en la alta sociedad? La locura no se detiene y las payasadas no terminan cuando estos dos hermanos cambian los trajes por las tangas. Mucha actitud, mucha música con ritmo y una memorable competencia de baile disco te mantendrán riendo de principio a fin en WHITE CHICKS, dos hermanos con los pies en la tierra. Casi.

programme.title: La Ley de Dan Candy
programme.desc: Basada en un hecho real, esta es la trágica historia del fugitivo de Saskatchewan Almighty Voice (Gordon Tootoosis), un indio Cree que es arrestado por robar ganado del gobierno por hambre desesperada.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (tal para cual)
programme.desc: La trama muestra como Trinidad descubre que Bambino ha sido injustamente condenado a muerte por el asesinato de dos pistoleros. Logrará sustituir al verdugo y salvarle de la muerte, huyendo con él en busca de los verdaderos autores del delito.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 40, 41, 42
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: El gran gato
programme.desc: Durante una sequía en Utah en los años 30, un puma amenaza al ganado y enfrenta a los granjeros. Danny se muda a la granja de su padrastro, atrapado entre tensiones familiares, un amor inesperado y el peligro creciente. Una fallida cacería al felino desata nuevas decisiones difíciles.

programme.title: Encontrando el amor en sisters
programme.desc: Esperanza, abogada exitosa, ve su vida desmoronarse. Tras la muerte de su madre, regresa a Sisters, Oregón, y debe enfrentarse a la distancia con sus hermanas Caridad y Faith, reconsiderando familia, recuerdos y reconciliación tras años de separación.

programme.title: Cacha de oro
programme.desc: Diego Palmiro, un legendario marchante de arte con demencia senil, se escapa de casa durante un peligroso negocio. Su hija Olga debe lidiar con el caos, gestionar a los socios y encontrar a Don Diego, quien descubre en la calle, junto al trovador Joselo, una versión peculiar de la libertad.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Riley viaja a Sudáfrica para conocer a la familia de su novio Mandla y descubre que es un príncipe. La revelación pone a prueba su confianza, y Mandla deberá demostrar que su amor es real más allá de su secreto.

programme.title: El comando
programme.desc: Un agente de la DEA con trastorno de estrés postraumático regresa a casa luego de una misión fallida. Ahora debe proteger a su familia de un ex convicto y sus secuaces liberados hace poco que buscan millones escondidos dentro de su casa.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y el tesoro perdido de Ugarit
programme.desc: Jack Hunter, arqueólogo, debe robar una tablilla de un museo en Francia y viaja a Damasco tras el asesinato de su amigo. Junto a Nadia y Tariq, enfrenta peligros de Albert Littman y descubre secretos mientras sigue la pista de la reliquia codificada de Ugarit.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Martin es un ex parisino que ha regresado a su pueblo natal en Normandía para hacerse cargo de la panadería de su padre. De su juventud le queda una gran imaginación y su pasión por la literatura, con un profundo aprecio por Gustave Flaubert. La emoción le invade cuando un matrimonio inglés se instala en la casa vecina, no sólo porque sus nombres son Gemma y Charles Bovery, sino porque sus comportamientos parecen replicar los de los personajes de la obra Madame Bovary, que incluye una serie de relaciones románticas y sexuales que se encaminan hacia un final incierto. Pero la hermosa Gemma no ha leído la novela clásica, y tiene la intención de vivir su propia vida, en especial cuando su antiguo novio, Patrick, aparezca de nuevo en su vida.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: Anita no pierde el tren
programme.desc: Anita ve como derriban el cine en el que trabaja como taquillera. A partir de ese día su vida cambia.

programme.title: Todos están muertos
programme.desc: Viendo a Lupe encerrada en casa, en bata y zapatillas, nadie diría que en los 80 fue una estrella del rock. La agorafobia no le permite salir de casa, y su madre, Paquita, se ocupa de ella y de su nieto adolescente. Pero a Paquita se le acaba el tiempo y no quiere marcharse sin recuperar a su hija.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: Cuando todo esté en orden
programme.desc: Una película honesta y sentida sobre las relaciones entre padres e hijos y la devastación que suponen las drogas.

programme.title: The Deadly Bees
programme.desc: Trouble strikes when an exhausted pop singer, sent on a vacation to a farm, realizes that the farm's owner grows deadly bees.

programme.title: The Perfect Husband
programme.desc: A married couple decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin, but the romantic journey takes a turn for the worse, when a sneaking suspicion becomes pure madness.

programme.title: Qué Pelo Más Guay
programme.desc: Un traficante de drogas de poca monta se topa con un baño que lo hace retroceder en el tiempo.

programme.title: Junglee
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra vuelve a casa, a la reserva de elefantes de su padre, donde tendrá que luchar contra unos cazadores furtivos.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Secuestrado en Rumanía
programme.desc: Dos periodistas italoamericanos han desaparecido mientras se encontraban en una misión en Rumanía.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: Cuando un misterioso desconocido llega a un hospital local al borde de la muerte, un interrogatorio del FBI desvela un complot internacional de venganza.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer 1
programme.desc: Un monje caucásico de Shanghai se infiltra en los bajos fondos para encontrar a los asesinos de su Gran Maestro espiritual femenino.

programme.title: Rescate en Afganistán
programme.desc: Un comando de las operaciones especiales, liderado por el experto francotirador Jake Chandler, es enviado a un poblado de Afganistan para rescatar a un congresista capturado por los talibanes. La misión es un éxito, pero Jake, se queda en el campo de batalla para salvar a un soldado herido.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: El super canguro
programme.desc: Bob Ho es un superespía secreto de la CIA que decide abandonar su carrera para sentar la cabeza con su novia, Gillian. Pero Bob tiene una última misión que cumplir antes de que Gillian acepte casarse con él: ganarse a sus tres testarudos hijos.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Pompeya, año 79 d.C. Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: Perfect weapon (Arma Perfecta)
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, una organización gubernamental y secreta dirigida por EL DIRECTOR controla todos los aspectos de la vida. Todos “los enemigos del estado” son castigados de manera severa y muchos de ellos son ejecutados mediante asesinos de la organización.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Un sicario novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo.

programme.title: Campus Code
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes se embarca en una búsqueda en la que deben sobrevivir a fuerzas desconocidas.
